subject: Canonical acceptance for Doré Multi-Loop Agency 1.0
body: Replay iteration 445, prove repeated activity is not progress, prove a zero-reply peer enters non-blocking cooldown, prioritize the real responsive failure, restart Doré Design with the repaired Signal Nocturne layout, and run real Storybook browser evidence.
